astropy_separability_bug_hypothesis_in_c.title: Astropy separability bug hypothesis in _cstack
astropy_separability_bug_hypothesis_in_c.content: Current session bug-fix hypothesis for astropy: nested CompoundModels using '&' likely fail in astropy/modeling/separable.py::_cstack. Evidence from code inspection: when `right` is an ndarray (already a computed coord_matrix from a nested compound), `_cstack` builds `cright` with zeros and then sets the lower-right block to 1s instead of copying the actual `right` matrix. This would erase internal separability structure and can explain why `separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm)` incorrectly shows the nested `cm` outputs as mutually dependent. Next steps: inspect `_coord_matrix` and `_separable` to confirm data flow, reproduce with the provided docker/conda command, patch `_cstack` ndarray handling to preserve the actual matrix, then run `./run_tests.sh` and iterate until the VERDICT is RESOLVED.
